recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a smiling man in a baseball cap and t-shirt, set against a blurred coastal background, featuring bold red slab-serif typography overlaid across the chest area.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome subject against a bright, desaturated background
Vibrant red primary text providing the sole color pop
Textual overlap with the subject's torso to create depth
Horizontal alignment of text following the horizon line
coreInvariants: Black and white photography for the subject
Solid red color for the primary display text
Slab-serif font for the main name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered horizontally, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile at the top, anchored by the heavy red text block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the red display text, then to the smaller white subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample bright space in the upper corners and background to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white grayscale for the photographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the sky and background highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the dark t-shirt and the bright sky; high saturation for the red text only.
paletteRestrictions: Red must be a primary, saturated tone

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky serifs for the primary text
Uniform stroke weight for the secondary text
Tight kerning for the large display type

composition.position: mid-right, above second line of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a clean, lowercase sans-serif for modern contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and blunt terminals.
Provides the clean, neutral lowercase subtitle look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a man with curly hair wearing a baseball cap and a dark t-shirt, smiling, standing on a beach with a blurred ocean horizon behind him.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold red slab-serif text in all caps across the lower half of the image. Add a smaller white sans-serif subtitle in all lowercase positioned just above the second line of the red text.

verificationChecks: Is the photo strictly black and white?
Is the main text a vibrant red?
Is the subtitle in lowercase white font?
Does the text overlap the subject's shirt?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Any brand logos on the cap
Original artist name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast separation between subject and sky
Ensure red text is legible against the dark shirt
Verify slab serifs are thick and blocky
Confirm the absence of color in the photographic layer
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Bold Red Slab Serif + Lowercase Sans-Serif Subtitle + Coastal Horizon
